AGENDA
PLANNING COMMISSION
MEETING
Upon request, the agenda and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act. Please contact the City Clerk at (310) 378-0383, at least 48 hours prior to the meeting to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.
Any person who has made campaign contributions to any of the members of the Planning Commission within twelve months before this meeting, should examine the provisions of Government Code Section 84308 which is posted on the bulletin board outside the Council Chamber.
We are advised by the members of the Commission that none of them have received campaign contributions within the last twelve months.
The applicant or any property owner entitled to notice of the hearing may, within fifteen days after the date of the Planning Commission decision, appeal the Planning Commission decision to the City Council (Ord. No. 091-529). A fee is required for filing an appeal with the City Clerkâ€™s office (R05-14).
The Council may, within fifteen days after the date of the decision or on or before the first date following the first Council meeting after the date of the Planning Commission decision, whichever occurs last: 1) Confirm the action of the Planning Commission and grant or deny the application; 2) Set the matter for public hearing and dispose of it in the same manner as on an appeal; or 3) Amend, modify, delete or add any condition of approval which the Council finds is not substantial under the circumstances relative to or affecting the property subject to the application for a development entitlement. Any determination of the Council pursuant to this paragraph shall be conclusive and final.
The Planning Commission reserves the right to modify the order of items shown on the agenda and advises all interested parties to arrive promptly at the commencement of the meeting.
CALL TO ORDER
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
ROLL CALL
COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC
Members of the audience are invited to address the Commission at this time on items that are not otherwise on the agenda. Per the California Government Code Section 54954.2, the Planning Commission is prohibited from discussing or taking immediate action on any item not on the agenda unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action arose subsequent to the posting of the agenda.

ACTION MINUTES
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  SEPTEMBER 17, 2019

Council Chambers  Tuesday
City Hall  September 17, 2019
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  6:30 p.m.
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL

Present: Lazzaro, Criley, Walker, Wade, Roos
Absent: None
Also present: Planning Manager Brianna Rindge, Planner Maddie Bright, Community Development &
Public Works Director Ken Rukavina, Assistant City Attorney John Cotti

COMMUNICATIONS FROM PUBLIC – None

CONSENT CALENDAR

1.  M-1337-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1141); Consideration of a Miscellaneous
  Application for a rear yard accessory structure above 8’ in height at the single-family residence
  located at 2805 Via Alvarado. Lot 8, Block 2234, Tract 7144. This project is exempt from
  CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Rainville Design Studio, 1632 Aviation Blvd, Redondo Beach, CA 90278
  Owner: Rodrigo & Diana Ibanez

  Action: Wade moved and Criley seconded to approve the application on consent (5-0 in favor)
  with standard conditions.

2.  M-1339-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1140); Consideration of a Miscellaneous
  Application for a rear yard accessory structure above 8’ in height at the single-family residence
  located at 1451 Via Castilla. Lot 57, Tract 27438. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant
  to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Alan McGregor, 16332 Bradbury Lane, Huntington Beach, CA 92647
  Owner: Steve & Stephanie Harris

  Action: Wade moved and Criley seconded to approve the application on consent (5-0 in favor)
  with standard conditions.

Planning Commission  1
Action Minutes
September 17, 2019
 OLD BUSINESS

3.  Zoning text amendment to the City’s municipal code amending Section 18.28 to establish
  procedures and standards for outdoor lighting in the R-1 single-family residential and R-M
  multifamily residential zones.

  Action: Criley moved and Roos seconded to recommend adoption of the ordinance proposed at the
  May 21, 2019 Planning Commission Meeting to City Council (5-0 in favor).

NEW BUSINESS

4.  M-1342-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1142); Consideration of a Miscellaneous
  Application for a rear yard accessory structure above 8’ in height and structures above 3’6” within
  the front yard setback at the single-family residence located at 1560 Via Zurita. Lot 2, Block 6,
  Tract 7334. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title
  14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Yani Wong, 4609 E. Anaheim St, Suite B, Long Beach, CA 90804
  Owner: Frank & Sandy Yang

  Continued to October Planning Commission meeting.

5.  M-1334-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1145); Consideration of a Miscellaneous
  Application for nonstandard encroachments at the single-family residence located at 108 Via Las
  Vegas. Lot 4, Block 6200, Tract 6887. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner: Denise Spampinato, 2120 Stanley Hills Dr, Los Angeles, CA 90406

  Action: Criley moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (5-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions and the following conditions: 1) Trees parallel to the road may be maintained at a
  height no higher than 8.5 feet; and 2) Any hedge parallel to the driveway shall be removed and
  may be replaced with vegetation that is in compliance with City Standards.

6.  M-1338-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1143); Consideration of a Miscellaneous
  Application for property line walls above 8’ in height at the single-family residence located at
  2208 Chelsea Road. Lot 2, Block 2211, Tract 6888. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant
  to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant/Owner: Ben Casey

  Speakers: Vic Overman, Jan Overman

  Action: Roos moved and Wade seconded to approve the application (5-0 in favor) with standard
  conditions.

Planning Commission  2
Action Minutes
September 17, 2019
 7.  NC-1540R-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1139); Consideration of a Revised
  Neighborhood Compatibility Application for a first floor addition and chimney additions at the
  single-family residence located at 908 Via Rincon. Lot 9, Block 1630, Tract 7142. This project is
  exempt from CEQA pursuant to California Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section
  15303.

  Applicant: George Sweeney, 3 Malaga Cove Plaza, Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274
  Owner: Cynthia Hu

  Speakers: David Booker, Susan Booker, Daniel Booker, Christa Perkins

  Action: Walker moved and Roos seconded to approve the application (4-0 in favor; Lazzaro
  recused) with standard conditions and the following conditions: 1) A standard urban stormwater
  mitigation plan, approved by the City Engineer shall be prepared and implemented for the project;
  2) This project is considered Hillside Residential and shall comply with Municipal NPDES Permit;
  3) Curb and gutter along property frontage with Via Rincon shall be installed. Engineering and
  design shall be in accordance with City standards; 4) The nine trees shown to be removed on Sheet
  1.1 of the plans associated with PCR-2015-0849 shall be removed; 5) No object, whether a
  permanent structure, or a temporary structure, or any object which is difficult to remove are
  allowed within sewer easements; and 6) The walkway shall be constructed per city standards.

8.  WTA-1-19 & CDP-116-19 (RESOLUTION NO. PCR-2019-1137); Consideration of Wireless
  Telecommunications Facility and Coastal Development Permit Applications for a new facility
  within City right-of-way at the northeast quadrant of Paseo Del Mar and Via Arroyo on the
  western edge of the parking lot. This project is exempt from CEQA pursuant to California
  Administrative Code Title 14, Chapter 3, Section 15303.

  Applicant: Crown Castle Fiber LLC, 200 Spectrum Center Dr #1800, Irvine, CA 92618
  Owner: City of Palos Verdes Estates

  Continued to October Planning Commission meeting.

9.  Ordinance No. O19-739 amending Section 17.08.378 (Short-term or Vacation Rental) of Chapter
  17.08 (Definitions) of Title 17 (Zoning Procedures) and Title 18 (Zoning Regulations) of the
  City’s Municipal Code regulating commercial events.

  Action: Walker moved and Criley seconded to recommend adoption of the ordinance proposed at
  the September 17, 2019 Planning Commission Meeting to City Council (5-0 in favor).

ITEMS OF INFORMATION

10.  November Meeting date.

  November meeting date scheduled for November 12, 2019.

11.  Administrative Approvals – Reviewed and filed.

Planning Commission  3
Action Minutes
September 17, 2019
 12.  Art Jury Meeting Schedule – Reviewed and filed.

ACTION MINUTES

13.  Meeting of July 16, 2019.

  Action: Wade moved and Criley seconded to receive and file (5-0 in favor).

Adjourned at 9:20 pm

Adjourn to the Planning Commission meeting on Tuesday, October 15, 2019 at 6:30 PM

This Planning Commission meeting may be viewed via live-stream or on demand thereafter on the City
website at www.pvestates.org.

Planning Commission  4
